summary: Lane County non-standard L-4 cab dated to the 1930s and removed or destroyed in the 1950s; the two detail sources disagree on which.

facts.status_note: Removed or destroyed in the 1950s; the register and firelookout.com disagree on which.

evidence.supports: built in the 1930s; non-standard L-4 cab; removed in the 1950s
evidence.quote: Built in the 1930s, this non-standard L-4 cab was removed in the 1950s.

evidence.supports: 1930s non-standard L-4 cab; destroyed in the 1950s
list shows it as Ground and Gone
evidence.quote: Westfir Lane 43.75240 -122.51730 Ground Gone FFLOS US 1001, OR 359

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the cab was removed in the 1950s; firelookout.com says it was destroyed in the 1950s. Both give the same decade, so the story reports both wordings.

notes_for_editor: Only two detail pages and the FFLA list; no built year, staffing, fire or site-today source found. The sources disagree on removed vs destroyed and give decade-only dates, so no built or removal event is recorded. The brief's note that Westfir shares a register number could not be confirmed: US 1001 appears twice in cached data/sources/fflos.json, both on this record, and I found no second holder. Lead for a future pass: the Willamette lookout thesis on ScholarsBank (scholarsbank.uoregon.edu/items/271eae30-098a-4fb7-b37c-048460d97265) had no text in cache; its PDF may name the Westfir cab.
